source.body:
<!-- pick-your-ai:ces-2027-topic-12 -->

## Problem, outcome and scope
Identify a single CES-sourced candidate that could contribute trustworthy structured catalog data under the existing pilot intake process.

## Prior work
Canonically tracked pilot work remains under [CP-16 #77](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-catalog-pipeline/issues/77) and [non-model pilot #79](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-catalog-pipeline/issues/79). Use [permitted acquisition #17](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-catalog-pipeline/issues/17), [manual intake #20](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-catalog-pipeline/issues/20), [source policy #41](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-research/issues/41) and [commercial display rights #60](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-research/issues/60). This issue supplies candidate-specific intake evidence.

## Deliverable
Dated source candidate matrix with an evidence packet for one potential pilot, or a documented no-fit disposition. Handoff goes through CP-16 qualification. Campaign reference CES-2027-12.

## Tasks and acceptance criteria
- [ ] Compare up to three leads from the [CES exhibitor directory](https://exhibitors.ces.tech/8_0/index.cfm). For each, cite vendor documentation and terms for the API/feed, field coverage, product identity, access approvals, fees/quotas, source dates and versions.
- [ ] Separate retrieval, internal research, display and redistribution rights. Check license scope, pricing/currency/billing units, corrections, freshness, change signals and withdrawal handling.
- [ ] Recommend one candidate or document why none qualifies. Supply evidence and missing rights to the pilot owner. Research-only or unclear rights cannot support inclusion in a published projection.

## Triage and verification
Open for a volunteer. Choose a reviewer from the receiving workstream when the work is accepted. Research, deliverable validation, and fresh-VM checks are pending where applicable.

## Prerequisites and handoffs
Under CP-16. Discovery can start with public, permitted evidence. Any selection, acquisition or catalog publication follows the existing pilot process and its independent rights and evidence review.

<!-- ces-2027-12-public-evidence-triage-20261123 -->
### 2026-11-23 — bounded, public-document *research* checkpoint (not a source approval)

Preliminary three-lead comparison, using **CES's [Unveiled Las Vegas exhibitor list](https://www.ces.tech/events/ces-unveiled-las-vegas/exhibitor-list)** as a candidate signal. This is **not equivalent to verification of a company profile in the [CES 2027 main exhibitor directory](https://exhibitors.ces.tech/8_0/index.cfm)**. No directory metadata was harvested and no vendor API was called.

| Preliminary lead | Public primary evidence / structured intake fit | Rights, access, quotas, source revision | Provisional disposition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Bosch** (Unveiled list) | [Home Connect developer documentation](https://developer.home-connect.com/support/faq) documents a *model-agnostic connected-appliance control API*, not a bulk product/model catalog feed. [Developer Agreement](https://developer.home-connect.com/developer_agreement) requires a registered account/client ID and governs appliance-related data and integrations. | Agreement has a post-2026-09-10 account version; applicability of that contract to *catalog republication* is **not established**. No catalog feed, field-level product IDs, public price/currency/billing meter, redistributable asset/license, update signal or quota evidence accepted. | **No-fit for this pilot on current evidence**; do not use device-control API as catalog authority. |
| **Belkin** (Unveiled list) | [Belkin Partner Advantage](https://www.belkin.com/business/partners/partner-advantage/) is a reseller application/approval program, not documented public catalog-data licensing. A [third-party Belkin product search API](https://www.trychannel3.com/product-data/brands/belkin) advertises structured titles, stable brand IDs, prices, merchants and availability; that advertisement **does not prove Belkin-granted downstream rights**. | Third-party landing page claims 1,000 free searches/month; **no call made** and API access/terms, chain-of-title, redistribution/display permission, canonical product IDs, pricing timestamp/version, withdrawal/update obligations and any fees beyond that claim are unverified. | **Hold** until provider/source-owner rights and stable field receipts exist. |
| **BLUETTI** (Unveiled list) | [Official website Terms of Service](https://www.bluetti.com/terms-of-service), effective **2026-09-20**, describe display of product names/models/specifications/manuals on its website, not a licensed programmatic catalog feed. | Website expressly warns model/spec fields can change by region or revision. No vendor-authorized feed, API quotas, durable change notifications, field reuse/display/redistribution license, pricing units or correction/withdrawal terms verified. | **No-fit on present evidence**; public reading does not confer publishing rights. |

**Rights gate (all three):** public documentation read for *research only*; automated retrieval permission **unassessed**; retention/internal research beyond this citation record **not approved**; catalog display **not granted**; redistribution **not granted**. Do not ingest, cache vendor content or publish a projection. Nothing here constitutes a source-use approval or a CES exhibitor-directory record.

**Exact unblock/evidence packet required:** (1) check each candidate's CES 2027 main-directory profile and dated vendor product feed/API docs; (2) capture field-level coverage, product identity, geographic variants, prices with currencies/billing units, quotas/fees, API version, source timestamp, change signal and withdrawal policy; (3) obtain an explicit decision for retrieval, internal retention, display and redistribution from the authorized source/use owner; (4) record a specific non-model pilot owner and independent affected-consumer review through [#77](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-catalog-pipeline/issues/77)/[#79](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-catalog-pipeline/issues/79), under [#17](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-catalog-pipeline/issues/17)/[#20](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-catalog-pipeline/issues/20). Until then, **no eligible candidate selected**; discovery remains open, pilot qualification is blocked.

No live API, credentials, deployment, spending, data publication, code change, issue closure or rights grant occurred.

<!-- ces-2027-main-directory-verification-20261123 -->
### 2026-11-23 — main CES 2027 exhibitor identity check; still no catalog source-use grant

Follow-up to the [preliminary three-lead rights triage](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-catalog-pipeline/issues/105#issuecomment-7096950902). Public, read-only checks of the **[official CES 2027 exhibitor directory](https://exhibitors.ces.tech/8_0/index.cfm)** now establish two individual main-show listings, rather than relying only on CES Unveiled:

| Candidate | Current primary exhibitor identity evidence | Catalog intake/rights outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Bosch** | [CES 2027 Bosch profile](https://exhibitors.ces.tech/8_0/exhibitor/exhibitor-details.cfm?exhid=0013000000k52rTAAQ), naming Bosch and listing the IoT/Sensors, Robotics, Smart Home & Appliances, Sourcing & Manufacturing and Vehicle Tech & Advanced Mobility categories. | **Exhibitor identity verified only**. No official catalog feed, grant for field reuse, product ID/version or commercial display/redistribution receipt obtained. Home Connect device-control API remains unsuitable evidence for catalog republication. |
| **Belkin International** | [CES 2027 Belkin International profile](https://exhibitors.ces.tech/8_0/exhibitor/exhibitor-details.cfm?exhid=0013000001KYVIBAA5), naming Belkin International and showing Accessories, Audio, Content & Entertainment, Cybersecurity and Gaming & Esports categories. | **Exhibitor identity verified only**. An exhibitor listing and distributor/partner advertising do not establish the rights chain for a third-party product-data API. |
| **BLUETTI Power Inc** | [CTA's CES Unveiled Las Vegas exhibitor list](https://www.ces.tech/events/ces-unveiled-las-vegas/exhibitor-list) names Bluetti Power Inc; its **individual main-show directory profile was not verified in this check**. | **Unveiled identity only**. No authorized catalog feed, revision/change stream, rights or product/price unit receipts. |

These pages identify exhibitors, **not approved machine-readable data suppliers**. No rights are inferred for retrieval, internal data retention, publication/display or redistribution; no product data ingested; no live vendor API called. A main-directory listing is distinct from a CES Unveiled listing, so the two verified profiles resolve *only part* of task 1.

**Exact remaining unblock:** independently confirm BLUETTI's main-show directory identity (or document its absence); for each retained lead, record a dated first-party feed/API specification with field set, stable product identifiers, versions, source timestamps, prices/currency, quotas/cost and correction/withdrawal signals; obtain source-owner written scope for each proposed use and receiving pilot/consumer acceptance under #77/#79. A documented no-fit disposition is permissible if no lead provides those receipts. Until then: **no eligible pilot feed selected; #105 remains open and blocked for admission**.

This is a new identity/provenance receipt, not an approval of a data feed, an independent PR review, completed issue, or operational release.
